score_100.reason: This merged rubric balances methodological accuracy with recovery of known biological cell types. It rewards the quantitative/methodological backbone (NBLAST-based hierarchical clustering of 2,143 neurons, dendrogram cut at a height of 8 yielding 22 distinct clusters) together with the visual presentation (individual clusters displayed side by side in the outline of the standard brain, gray) and the biological validation of the clustering (asterisks denoting known cell types, specifically cluster 13 = oculomotor neurons and cluster 14 = retinal ganglion cells/RGCs). These elements together define the main contribution of the panel: recovery and visualization of known neuronal cell classes plus candidate novel morphotypes. Minor rendering or layout details should receive little weight unless they help preserve the core meaning.

rubric.GT core conclusion: 2,143 neurons were classified by morphology and innervation pattern using NBLAST and subjected to hierarchical clustering based on similarity scores (Figure 6A); the dendrogram was cut at a height of 8 to yield 22 distinct clusters, and individual clusters of neurons are displayed side by side in the outline of the standard brain (gray), with asterisks denoting clusters of known cell types including cluster 13 (oculomotor neurons) and cluster 14 (retinal ganglion cells, RGCs).

Scoring items.criterion: States that 2,143 neurons were classified by morphology and innervation pattern using NBLAST-based hierarchical clustering (Figure 6A)
Scoring items.deduction_rule: Deduct 20 points if NBLAST classification or the link to hierarchical clustering is missing or replaced by only a generic description of similarity. Deduct 8-12 points if NBLAST is mentioned but the neuron count (2,143) is substantially incorrect or omitted.

Scoring items.criterion: Indicates that the dendrogram was cut at a height of 8 to yield 22 distinct clusters
Scoring items.deduction_rule: Deduct 25 points if the 22-cluster outcome is missing. Deduct 10-12 points if the 22 clusters are mentioned but the dendrogram cut height (8) is omitted or incorrect.

Scoring items.criterion: Reports that individual clusters are displayed side by side in the outline of the standard brain (gray)
Scoring items.deduction_rule: Deduct 20 points if the side-by-side display or the overlay on the standard brain outline is missing. Deduct 8-10 points if the standard brain is mentioned but the side-by-side comparative layout or gray outline is substantially incorrect.

Scoring items.criterion: Identifies that asterisks denote clusters of known cell types, specifically naming cluster 13 (oculomotor neurons) and cluster 14 (retinal ganglion cells, RGCs)
Scoring items.deduction_rule: Deduct 35 points if the recovery of known cell types is completely missed. Deduct 15-18 points if known cell types are mentioned but the specific biological examples (oculomotor neurons and RGCs) are omitted. Deduct 5-8 points if the cell types are correctly named but the mention of asterisks or specific cluster numbers (13, 14) is missed.

Acceptable deviations: Paraphrasing 'NBLAST' as 'morphological similarity scoring' or 'NBLAST-based clustering' is acceptable if the hierarchical clustering context is preserved
Reporting the neuron count approximately (e.g., ~2,143 neurons) is acceptable
Omitting the explicit 'Figure 6A' reference is acceptable if the hierarchical clustering step is clearly stated
Omitting the explicit mention of 'gray' for the brain outline is acceptable if the 'standard brain outline' concept is retained
Minor rephrasing of 'side by side' (e.g., 'displayed individually next to each other') is acceptable
Referring to clusters without the exact numbers 13/14 is acceptable if the oculomotor neurons and RGCs are explicitly identified as known cell types marked with asterisks
rubric.Scoring instructions: Full credit requires capturing the neuron population, NBLAST hierarchical clustering (Figure 6A), the dendrogram cut at height 8 yielding 22 clusters, the side-by-side display in the gray standard brain outline, and the asterisk labeling of known cell types with the specific biological examples (cluster 13 oculomotor neurons and cluster 14 RGCs). Partial credit should be given when the answer preserves the clustering result and known-type recovery but simplifies numbers or visualization details. Low scores should be assigned when the answer reduces the figure to a generic visual description or omits the biological validation (oculomotor neurons and RGCs) or the core quantitative clustering outcome.
